Issuance of a New Work Permit - Temporary Work Permits

Under this permit, an employee completes a specific task.

Conditions & Requirements

  • The employee must be 18 years of age or older.
  • The establishment must maintain a valid license.
Permit Duration

6 months

Type of Employment Contracts

Full Time / Part Time / Temporary Work

Service completion duration

2 working days

Service Fees

  • Federal fees of 50 dirhams
